name: Qatar Foundation
verdict: A not-for-profit foundation created by the late Father Amir of Qatar and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, and chaired by Sheikha Moza.
note: Rating note: BAL partner since 2026 (the league's first Official Community Partner); its logo is displayed on the back of all BAL game uniforms, including Al Ahly's 2026 jersey (BAL release, 14 May 2026 — a collaboration 'facilitated by Qatar Sports Investments'). Confirmed among the record 22 marketing, merchandising and institutional partners supporting the BAL in the 2026 season (pr.nba.com/2026-basketball-africa-league-season-numbers, 2026-05-25); the QF logo sits on the upper back of JCA Kings' 2026 BAL uniform in the BAL's official game photo cdn-bal.nba.com/manage/sites/3/2026/05/JCA-Kings-vs-ASC-Ville-Dakar-5-scaled.jpg. On hold for a maintainer: QF was created by the late Father Amir of Qatar and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser (qf.org.qa/about), she is its Chairperson, and its Vice Chairperson is Her Excellency Sheikha Hind bint Hamad Al Thani (QF CEO announcement, 22 May 2025). Whether this ruling-family leadership amounts to Qatari state control of the foundation under METHOD.md is undecided — compare QIPCO, an Al Thani family company kept unrated. If the state is held to control it, the state's migrant-worker record (qatar-migrant-worker-abuse-2025, government-of-qatar-record) would reach the sponsor.
